items.html: When the seven Orot rose upward, the Kelim that descended into Beriarose upward to Atzilut as well. However, they did not join together. The seven Orot were in a state of Ibur and “Gimel contained in Gimel”, and the Nekudat (Nekuda of) Malchut was their seventh, in the form of Psia le Bar. Likewise, the seven Kelim were also in that manner, Gimel contained in Gimel, and Malchutalong with them.
